projectDescription: Open-source React UI components library built with Tailwind CSS for beautiful documentation sites
keyFeatures: 22 production-ready React components for documentation sites
Built with Tailwind CSS v3 and v4 support
Full TypeScript support with exported types
Dark mode support with theme-aware styling
Syntax highlighting with Shiki and copy-to-clipboard
Accessible components with ARIA attributes and keyboard navigation
publicApiSurface: Accordion - Expandable content sections with icon and URL state support
Badge - Status and label badges
Callout - Highlighted information boxes (info, warning, note, tip, check, danger)
Card - Content cards with optional images, icons, and CTAs
CodeBlock - Syntax-highlighted code blocks with Shiki
CodeGroup - Tabbed or dropdown code block container
Color - Color display components
Columns - Multi-column layout component
Expandable - Collapsible sections
Frame - Image and content frames
Icon - Icon rendering with multiple library support
Mermaid - Interactive diagram rendering with zoom/pan controls
Panel - Panel layout component
Property - API property documentation display
Search - Search component with modal and keyboard navigation
Steps - Step-by-step instruction component with anchor links
Tabs - Tabbed interface with keyboard navigation
Tile - Tile grid layout
Tooltip - Hover tooltips with positioning control
Tree - Hierarchical tree view component
Update - Changelog entry component
View - Conditional rendering utility
cn - Utility function for class name merging
